limits: Static source/descriptor/register gate, not NPU accuracy or speed.
No all-BF16 exactness claim; underflow/cancellation requires actual down boundary oracle.

TRF/VRF term indexing and reduction order are bound to emitted symbolic mapping, source and schedule; binary SFR reader instructions and arithmetic are not independently emulated. Actual oracle is required.
Inherited E128 up quantizer and untouched boundaries retain prior evidence; this does not independently certify every inherited DMA.
